alert.finding: In Proof 2.1, lem-hh-quantum-and-hecke-tensor-actions-commute states: “every earlier summand restricts to $K_i\otimes K_i$ or $K_i^{-1}\otimes K_i^{-1}$, and every later summand to the identity.” This classification is incorrect for the displayed F_i coproduct sum. For a summand indexed by r and checked positions a,a+1, r < a gives the identity on those positions, whereas r > a+1 gives K_i⁻¹ ⊗ K_i⁻¹. For example, with n = 3 and a = 1, the r = 3 summand is K_i⁻¹ ⊗ K_i⁻¹ ⊗ F_i. The existing Cartan commutation check handles either location, so this is a local proof-text gap rather than a counterexample to the lemma.
